title: Battle for Zendikar/Intro packs
description: MTG Wiki (Category:Battle for Zendikar block intro packs)

paragraphs.text: Battle for Zendikar has five intro packs (three bicolored and two colorless):
Rallying Cry is a intro pack centering around Ally Zendikari and the Rally mechanic.
1 Resolute Blademaster
2 Shatterskull Recruit
2 Lithomancer's Focus
2 Smite the Monstrous
The rares in this deck are Hero of Goma Fada ( alternate art foil ) and Angelic Captain .
Swarming Instinct is a colorless intro pack centering around Eldrazi , Scion tokens and the Devoid mechanic.
2 Kozilek's Channeler
1 Unnatural Aggression
2 Scour from Existence
The rares in this deck are Drowner of Hope ( alternate art foil ) and Desolation Twin .
Call of Blood is a intro pack centering around life gain and the alternate win condition of Felidar Sovereign .
2 Kalastria Nightwatch
The rares in this deck are Defiant Bloodlord ( alternate art foil ) and Felidar Sovereign .
Eldrazi Assault is a colorless intro pack centering around Eldrazi , and the Devoid and Ingest mechanics.
2 Forerunner of Slaughter
2 Transgress the Mind
The rares in this deck are Barrage Tyrant ( alternate art foil ) and Serpentine Spike .
Zendikar's Rage is a intro pack centering around the Landfall mechanic.
1 Makindi Sliderunner
The rares in this deck are Oran-Rief Hydra ( alternate art foil ) and Nissa's Renewal .
